chapter: Building McShann's big band and blues records
title: Martin's and the Continental, and Charlie Barnet's offer hidden from Ramey
summary: Three months at Martin's, then switching with the Continental; McShann and Tumino concealed Barnet's offer.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So after (unintelligible) this period with the small group at Martin's on the Plaza, what then?

Well, now, we had that for quite a while. We started, now, and in the middle, later part of April, '38, and we stayed at Martin's On the Plaza maybe three months. And then we switched over to the Continental. They had called us when we first started working there -- it wasn't the Continental, it was something else. But anyway, then we would go back to Martin's. It was just like we would switch between those two jobs.
And it was there, in '38, I got the offer from Charlie Barnet to come. This was when McShann hid me.

He hid me, you know. I didn't even know about it. They approached McShann, they wanted to hire me to come with Charlie Barnet, you know. And so McShann, when the guy told him, instead of McShann telling me, you know, go ahead, be happy, in the meantime he and John Tumino got together and stuck me off in the corner somewhere.
